//: Typechecks the `room` Edge Function with this repository's own TypeScript.
Deliberately NOT referenced from the root tsconfig. This code targets the Deno edge runtime,
imports supabase-js by an `npm:` specifier and calls a global `Deno` — none of which belong in
the browser build's project graph. Wiring it into `tsc -b` would have meant relaxing the app's
own settings to accommodate a bundle the app never loads.
The settings below mirror tsconfig.app.json where it matters (strict, verbatimModuleSyntax,
erasableSyntaxOnly, allowImportingTsExtensions), so the vendored engine copies are held to the
same standard here as their originals are in lib/engine.
`types: []` is load-bearing: this project has no @types/node, and picking up ambient globals
the edge runtime does not provide would let a mistake through.
